name: GRU Volume Fusion
definition: A recurrent neural network that incrementally fuses local feature volumes $\{V_t\}$ per frame into a global volume $V^g$ using GRUs with sparse 3D CNNs.
summary: GRU Volume Fusion incrementally aggregates sparse local feature volumes into a global radiance field using Gated Recurrent Units to adaptively update only relevant voxels.
